mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In any 12-month rolling window, the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS decline is below 0.02, or the 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.5% for 3 months, or the Rank IC for the threshold condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the joint decline of HOUST and RSAFS is below 0.02, or the 20-day forward returns in periods of joint decline are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle economic regime characterized by low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%), a further decline in the unemployment rate signals an overheating labor market that forces the Federal Reserve to accelerate rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 3.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past quarter indicates robust manufacturing activity and strong corporate earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO growth is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or the 60-day forward returns in periods of rising INDPRO are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,300,000 units for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the residential sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1300.0 for two months, the 5-day forward returns are positive, or the Rank IC for the threshold is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a rise in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the joint increase of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL is below 0.02, or the 20-day forward returns in periods of joint increase are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-stage expansion regime (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% for two consecutive quarters), a further acceleration in GDP growth signals an overheating economy that triggers Federal Reserve rate hikes, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 growth > 2.0% for 2 quarters, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the condition is below 0.03.
